groundTruth.rootCause: The cart service fails 10% of EmptyCart requests, so checkout's PlaceOrder calls fail.

hypothesis: Low confidence: one short connection failure between cart and its Redis/valkey store (about 09:00:36) made a single cart call fail, and that error reached checkout. This was a one-off partial failure of about 1–2% of checkout calls for 1–2 minutes, not an outage, and it has already cleared. The evidence does not fully explain it: payment shows one error span at the same time but logged no failed charge, so the exact source of the errors is not proven. No remediation is proposed.
